description: Connect a send-only mailbox: the SMTP login a sending service gives you (Amazon SES, Postmark, SendGrid and others), for your app's transactional email. We sign in to its SMTP server first, and the server must ask for the login. If it fails, nothing is saved and it answers 400, with `details` as connect_mailbox describes plus one more `code`: `login_not_offered` (the server did not ask for a login, so we could not check this SMTP access): use the SMTP host your sending service gives you. `username` is required: a sending service's SMTP username is rarely the address. The mailbox is always transactional: it sends only send_transactional_message, never campaigns or new messages, and it never warms up. We can't read mail sent to its address, so replies go wherever the rest of your domain's mail goes; set `replyTo` on the mailbox (update_mailbox) or on an email to choose. A receiving server that refuses an address while we send stops that address, as for any mailbox; we read no bounce report that comes later. It needs a plan with transactional email (402 PLAN_GATE, before any login is tried) and counts toward the plan's mailboxes. If the check can't finish in 15 seconds it answers 503 and saves nothing: try again. A working login does not prove that the address is yours: nothing sends from this mailbox until request_mailbox_confirmation and confirm_mailbox_address confirm it. Leave `handoffId` out with an API key: it is for the console, and a key that sends it gets 400. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: connect_send_only_mailbox
title: Connect a send-only mailbox
